# en 120x40（竖线是窗口右缘）
                                                         Anpai                                                          |
                                                                                                                        |
               Pick a session in the left pane to show it here. Sessions keep running in the background.                |
                                                                                                                        |
              F2      Take over the sub agent on screen (switching away, hiding, or Ctrl-Q hands it back)               |
              Ctrl-Q  Send the session in the center back to the background (it keeps running)                          |
              F5      Show or hide the left pane                                                                        |
              F6      Show or hide the right pane                                                                       |
              F7      Show or hide the bottom pane                                                                      |
              F8      Deliver queued reports to the main agent now                                                      |
              F9      Agent settings                                                                                    |
              F10     Focus the center pane                                                                             |
